build_transformer_model: build a legacy transformer model instance using TransformerModel.build_model with args and task
add_transformer_args: add transformer model-specific arguments to an argparse parser using TransformerModel.add_args
build_transformer_encoder: build a transformer encoder using TransformerModel.build_encoder with args, source dictionary, and embed tokens
build_transformer_decoder: build a transformer decoder using TransformerModel.build_decoder with args, target dictionary, and embed tokens
list_transformer_hub_models: list available pretrained transformer hub models using TransformerModel.hub_models for WMT and Flores checkpoints
